ns2:section.sectionText: Lecture and Lab are required. This course is delivered in a Hybrid mode, which combines on-campus work with some content accessed on-line. It is also possible to study this in a wholly on-line mode for people who do not wish to be campus-based. As with all our courses, it is possible that the delivery mode may vary through the semester as events unfold with the Coronavirus pandemic.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Industrial Design or Sustainable Design major(s).
